# voipms_balance (Data Source)

Account balance from the VoIP.ms `getBalance` API (advanced breakdown).


## Example Usage

```terraform
data "voipms_balance" "account" {}

output "current_balance" {
  value = data.voipms_balance.account.current_balance
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `calls_today` (String) Call charges today.
- `calls_total` (String) Total call charges.
- `current_balance` (String) Current account balance.
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier (always `balance`).
- `spent_today` (String) Amount spent today.
- `spent_total` (String) Total amount spent.
- `time_today` (String) Call time today.
- `time_total` (String) Total call time.
